tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rnam thos sras kyi mchod sprin 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'byor pa'i dbang phyug ches 'tsho bar// 'dod la rnam thos sras mchod pa// ma tshang med rgyu yin shes nas// yi ge 'di la 'bad par bya// rnam thos sras mchod par 'dod pas/ bcas man ngag gi gzhung ji bzhin byas nas/ bdag nyid rdo rje rnam 'joms mthing kar gsal btab nas/ mdun du lha'i yul 'khor nyams dga' ba/ skyed mos kyi tshal dang*/ khrus kyi rdzing bu dang*/ rin po che'i shing nags/ sman gyi ri ljongs/ padmo dang me tog gi gling*/ spos kyi myu gus khyab pa/ bya dang ri dwags gcan gzan yid du 'ong ba rnams bag phebs pa/ lha'i dka' thub pa bsam gtan la gnas shing*/ lha klu gnod sbyin la sogs pa'i bu dang bu mo sna tshogs pas rtsed 'jo rgyun mi 'chad pa/ dri za'i glu dang rgyud mangs sbyar ba'i sgra snyan pa snyan pas khebs pa'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa bzo dbyibs bkod pa'i khyad par thams cad kyis blta na ngom pa med pa'i gzhal med kyi khang brtsegs mtho nam mkha' lding gi mchod sdong lta bu/ phyogs mtshams su khang pa brtsegs pa brgyad/ 'khor yug tu gnod sbyin rnams kyi grong khyer/ ra ba dang*/ bsil khang dang sgo khang la rta babs dang*/ 'obs rim pa mang po zam pa dang*/ stegs bu yid du mchis pa du mas bskor zhing*/ lha'i longs spyod chen po sus kyang bsgrun du med pas brgyan pa'i dbus su/ bai las chos skyong ba'i rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras gser gyi lhun po la nyi ma 'bum bsgril ba'i 'od kyis 'khyud pa lta bu'i sku rgyas pa'i byin chags pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos dang go khrab kyis rgya nag po'i dpa' bo bzhin du lhab lhub tu brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas lha klu mi'i bsam 'phel gyi nor bu gsum ka'ang rgyal mtshan gyi rtser mchod pa dang*/ g.yon nor bu skyug bzhin pa'i ne'u le'i mgrin pa btsir nas rgyal po rol pa'i 'gying bag gis gter gyi bum pa brgyad kyi khar 'phrog byed nyal ba'i khri la bzhugs pa/

btsun mo dpal chen mo bum pa bzang po bzung nas zho 'thung byis pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ las byed mdung dmar can sku mdog dmar po g.yas mdung ba dan dmar po can 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon shel gyi mchod rten bum pa nas rin po che sna tshogs 'bab pa bsnams shing*/ bswe rmog dang bswe khrab gyon pa/ gzhan yang mngag gzhug nang mi snag gi gnyen sku srung gi dmag tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi khang par gter gyi bdag po brgyad ser po/ rin po che dang utpal sngon po'i phreng bas brgyan cing*/ phyag gnyis kyis bum pa bzang po 'dzin pa/ tsan 'khyil gyis gter gyi bum pa'i khar bzhugs pa la/ 'khor gnod sbyin bye ba phrag 'bum rnams kyis bskor ba/ de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying ga'i cha stod du hūm̐/ smad du bais mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ ri rab chen po'i byang phyogs/ gnod sbyin chen po rnams kyi mdun sa/ lcang lo can nas chos skyong ba'i rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin gyi phung po 'khrigs pa lta bur spyan drangs/ badzra sa ma dzaḥ sa spyan drangs par bsam la dbyangs snyan zhing rol mo sna tshogs pa dang*/ dri zhim po'i spos bsregs te/ 'di skad gyer ro// bai/ gter bdag chen po'i 'jig rten khams// mtho ris mi yul sa 'og gi /dga' dang skyid pa'i dpal tshogs pa// lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas// rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras// bka' blon gter gyi bdag po brgyad// 'bangs 'khor bsam mi khyab pa rnams// bdag gi dad pas spyan 'dren no// 'jig rten khams kyi dbul 'joms pa// khyed kyi dam bca' ma lags sam// gzhan don 'di yi dus bab kyi// ma thogs la 'ur gshegs su gsol// zhes spyan drangs/ bskyed pa la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa lngas dbang bskur/

bdud rtsis lus gang rigs kyi bdag po rin chen 'byung gnas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur pa la dngos su 'byor ba rnams phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos por bsam/ gzhan yid kyis nus tshad sprul/ 'jig rten gyi khams gang na yod pa de thams cad kyang 'bul lo snyam blos gzung nas 'di skad gyer ro// bai/ manda ra dang a kar nag po'i spos// snang gsal kun dang sbrul gyi snying po'i rdzab// lha mi'i bza' btung snyan pa'i rol sgra dang*// rin chen sna bdun bkra shis rdzas kyi rigs// 'dod 'jo'i ba phyugs bzhon pa 'dod pa lnga// rgyal mtshan lhab lhub rlung g.yob gdugs 'phan dang*// lda ldi gter bum dga' bar byed pa'i rgyan// rngam pa'i dgra cha sra ba'i go cha dang*// bsrel 'os dkon sna lha klu mis bsngags pa/ dngos su 'byor bshams gzhan ni yid kyis sprul// 'di na yod mos blo yis gzung nas kun// rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// de nas gtor ma oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ sbyangs rtogs sbar bdud rtsir byas pa/ oṃ bai shra ba ṇa sa pa ri wā ra/ i daṃ ba li kha kha khā hi khā hi btags la phul/ /rtag tu mig ni ya mtshan ltad mos brel// rna bar gtam snyan 'ba' zhig snar dri zhim// lce la ro brgya ldan pa'i bza' btung mod// lus la reg 'jam mdzes pa'i gos rgyan gsar/ mnga' thang 'bangs 'khor nor phyugs dar zab 'bru// rin chen bang mdzod khyod dang mnyam pa dang*// yid la ci 'dod bsam pa'i mod nyid du// lhun gyis grub pa rnams kyi dngos grub stsol// zhes dngos grub blangs te bstod pa ni/ bai/ 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs bsam 'phel nor bu'i dbang*// re ba thams cad ster ba'i dpag bsam dang*// smon pa 'phral la 'grub pa'i bum pa bzang*// ngal bsos dge ba khyod la bdag bstod do// dga' ba'i rin chen kun 'byung rgya mtsho che// skyid pa'i myu gus rtag 'gengs dbang chen sa// bde ba'i dpal 'gyed 'phags pa nam mkha'i mdzod// gter bdag chen po khyod la bdag bstod do// 'od kyis nyi ma pham byed gser gyi sku// rdo rje'i khrab bgos bdud kyi dpung 'joms shing*// sangs rgyas bstan pa kun tu skyong mdzad pa'i// rnam thos sras po khyod la bdag bstod do// khams gsum dbang sdud gter bum gdong lnga'i khrir// 'gying ba'i phyag g.yas nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang*// nor bu skyug pa'i ne'u le 'dzin pa// rmugs 'dzin rgyal po khyod la bdag bstod do// ci bsgo'i las la thogs med 'phrin las pa// dpa' zhing rtul phod lha yi gyad chen po// gos sngon gyis mdzes nor sbyin tshogs chen po'i// sde dpon 'khor bcas khyod la bdag bstod do//

zhes man ngag bzhin bzla/ sarba gatstsha sa rten nam rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs so// 'di yang padma dkar pos sngags grwa slob dpon ngag dbang kun dga' snying po'i ngor sbyar ba'o// maṅgalaṃ// ༈ rnam thos sras kyi bstod pa bzhugs so// bhrūṃ las rin chen sna bdun khang brtsegs mchog /dpal gyi rngams chen khor yug grong khyer 'byor// skyed tshal nags klung nyams dga' lcags ri'i phyogs// phun tshogs mkhar brgyad skyid brod kho na'i dbus// bai las dzambu'i gser mdog dar bab sku// 'od zer rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs 'khrug pa can// rnam rgyal bzhin ras zhal ni 'dzum che ba// shangs kyi gzengs ran spyan 'bras khra la hur// smin 'khyog 'dod pa'i gzhu ste sa gsum po'i// na chung thams cad chags pa'i spu long g.yo// mgul zlum stod rgyas sked sbom yan lag rags// thung min n+yā gro dha ltar chu zheng gab// cod pan rol pa'i pa tra phra tshoms can// gtsug rgyan yid bzhin nor bu nyi mar 'khu// snyan cha se mo do shal lhab lhub gos// brgya byin mnabs snyam srang la bcal ba bzhin// de steng dmar ser rdo rje'i khrab bgos pa// phas kyi mtshon gzon du min ci slad na// sred med bu yi stobs ldan gyad chen khyod// phyogs dus gar yang rgyal ba'i dpal mtshan no// phyag g.yas rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i za ma tog /lha klu mi yi bsam 'phel gsum bkod nas// rgya mtsho'i dus rlabs mi yol de lta bur// dus dus rin chen char chen 'bebs pa nyid// g.yon pa na ku le yi mgrin btsir nas// nor bu skyug bcug 'phongs pa la bkye bas// ngal bsos dge ba zhes bstod mgrin pa'i rnga// khyod mdun tsam min gar yang brdung bar gyur// gdong lnga'i nga rgyal chen pos pha rol steng*// mchong gsar 'phrul mig gyen bskyong ral tshogs kyis// cud zad 'then pa stobs chen sha ra bhar// nor bu'i 'chong 'chong mang 'phyang gser sga gtad// rgyal po chen po rol pas der 'gying yang*// rnam gzigs nyam nga'i phyogs lhung skyob rings pa// thos pa'i skyogs kyis bzed 'os sangs rgyas kyi// sras mchog rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal bstod// gser mdog nyi ma'i gzi lan dzambha la// go cha cher bgos rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng*// bdud kyi sgyu 'dul lta sma skad zhan par// slong ba'i re skong myur po de la bstod// phyogs bcu gur kum mkhur tshos gang ba bzang*// go can cang shes steng nas ngan gzhol kun// tshar gcod dge la zhugs rnams ci smon pa// 'phral sgrub bum bzang kha 'byed de la bstod// rab dkar bdud rtsi'i 'od 'phro nor bu bzang*// lha yi go mdzes sprin shugs khar rtse zhing*// srid pa'i dbang chen kun 'khor thub pa'i bstan// kun gyi srid zhus skyong ba de la bstod// glog drag g.yo ba'i sprin nag ku be rā// zhub bcas rta la dpa' skyen rdo rje'i lce// brgya phrag 'phangs nas bstan dgra'i mgo 'gems pas// ral gri'i gnyen du gyur pa de la bstod// mdog ser rgyal po'i mdzod pa yang dag shes// yid myur rtar bcibs mi mthun phyogs 'joms shing*/

ci dgos thams cad bsams pa'i mod sbyor ba// dbul gdungs grib bsil bla med de la bstod// gser gyi mdangs can dmag gi dpon lngas rtsen// go sprad bkod bshams 'thab zhugs lha min rnams// g.yul ngor pham byas de bzhin thams cad du// rgyal ba'i rnga chen nyid brdung de la bstod// mun pa mun nag 'thibs 'dra 'brog gnas pa// btsan pa'i go gyon rlung ltar 'phyo ba'i rta// phyor bas dgra dpung 'thor nas 'ded brod pa// shākya'i bu rdzi chen po de la bstod// ku muta rgyas 'dra pi tsi kuṇḍa li// ya lad khrab can rta gsar rgyug thengs res// gling bzhi myul bas ma rungs rnams 'joms pa// chos kyi mel tshe mkhan po de la bstod// rgya mtsho brgyad gnas dbang por bcas pa'i klu// brag rdzong gnod sbyin bzhin mi sdug gtum pa// khams gsum sde brgyad dkar po'i phyogs zhen can// kun gyi sde dpon khyod la bdag bstod kyi// thugs rje'i gzigs pa bul min ches lhag pa// la 'ur btsal bas mchog sbyin mdzod cig ces// yan lag mchog btud thal sbyar gdung shugs kyi// mchi ma bku ba'i ngag gis zhu gsol lo// maṅga laṃ/// / ༄༅// rnam thos sras kyi rin chen khang 'bul bzhugs so// bai/ dzambu'i gser dang rin chen bai ḍūrya// ind+ra nī la mthon ka mthon ka che// marga man shel padma rā ga dang*// rdo yi snying po las grub khang brtsegs ni// dbyibs mdzes brgya byin pho brang rnam rgyal bzhin// 'od kyi gzi 'bar nyin mor byed pa bzhin// zhal bas dwangs pas ston ka'i gnam sngon bzhin// bzo khyad 'thon pa mkha' lding mchod sdong bzhin// lha rdzas yo byad kyis bkang rgya mtsho dang*// gnod sbyin grong gi blta na sdug pa dang*// sgo lcog lcang lo can dang 'khor sa dang*// skyed tshal nags klung bde ba can gnyis pa// gang zhig mthong ba'i mod la myos pa dang*// rngam che gzhal bar tshad kyis 'phongs pa dang*// rgya khyon chen pos nam mkha'i khyon bsgrib pa// chos kyi rgyal po rtag tu rtsen sar 'bul//

rta 'bul ni/ bai/ rta mchog sprin gyi shugs ldan cang shes pa// sha rgyas lus grims gang bltas yid 'phrog pa// rkang lag 'khyug myur glog 'gyu'i dpal 'dzin pa// 'gros kyis nyi ma'i bzhon pa bul por bzo// drug bkrag 'dres pa'i g.yu yi spu kha yis// dar bab rma bya'i mgrin mdangs mog byed la// rngog ma stug po lan bur byas pa ni// dzambu'i snye ma gshibs pa'i 'dzum yang gnon// rnga ma gar mkhan ma yi skra tshogs ltar// phud du bcings dang thur du grol ba nyid// gdong par gser gyi drwa ba srab skyogs can// spyi bor dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs lhab lhub dbus// pad dmar tog bkod de bzhin sna gdong dpyid// mu tig dkar dmar sngo ba'i dom dom dang*// zab sku glas pa'i srad bu nor bu ni// phyogs phyogs phrag brang brla'i zur 'chang ba// spu lan long khebs stong khun ding phon dang*// shel sga nor bu'i phra tshom 'ja' tshon ris// gser chas pa tra'i thog mar 'brug gzugs sogs// rnam 'gyur bzo rtsed stong phrag ltad mo can// skabs bab rin chen thi gu'i dra ba la// dzhai kṣiṃ dril bu'i g.yer kha sing khrol sgrog /yob bcas ind+ra nī la'i rta chams ni// zla gdan gnam gyi phyogs 'ga' dras pa bzhin// de ltar rnam par mdzes byed rgyan kun gyis// lha dbang rtsed 'jor chas pa'i bzhon pa bzhin// legs par brgyan pa sde dpon chen po khyod// dbul 'phogs 'joms su phebs pa'i chibs su 'bul// ba 'bul ni/ bai/ dmar ser li khri'i thig le chen po 'di// gnam gyi me long nyi mar mtshon 'os shing*// yid la 'dod pa thams cad 'jo bas na// bco lnga'i zla rgyas nyid du kun gyis bzung*// ind+ra nī la'i rmig pa yid tsam du// 'bur ba'i rwar bcas gang gi nu ma'i 'bur// sor mo'i 'du byed rgyal mtshan rtser 'khod pa'i// gnas skabs las gzhan bsam 'phel nor bu'i dbang*// ma rmos ma btab sā lu'i kha zas can// dpag bsam shing gi nags su 'gro ba yang*// ltad mo'i dam pa mtho ris do rar ni// chas bcug me na ka yi gar bzhin no// cung zad bskul ba'i rnga ma'i 'gying log ni// bde sogs bdag por g.yob pa'i rnga yab snyam// yid 'bab ha ri tsan dan dri bzhon kun// bos pa bzhin du de yi mdun na rgyu// gdangs dris padma'i sdong por 'di 'khrul nas// rkang drug dar ma thams cad 'dir 'phur pa// sbrang rtsi'i chang gis myos pa'i skyur 'gong ste// de ltar ma nor 'dod 'jo'i ba 'di 'bul// maṅga laṃ/// /
